## Description
Briefly explain the motivation for this change and summarize the technical implementation.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] ♿ Accessibility enhancement (improvements to contrast, screen reader, touch targets)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🔒 Security or RLS policy fix

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and architecture of this project
- [ ] I have run `npm test` and all 67 tests pass
- [ ] I have run `npx tsc --noEmit` and there are no TypeScript errors
- [ ] I have run `npx expo-doctor` and there are no dependency discrepancies
- [ ] I have not committed any secrets (`.env`, `google-services.json`, private keys)
